title: Ideal Ground Truth Sensor
source_docs: Automated Driving Toolbox/Driving Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Ideal_Ground_Truth_Sensor.md
text: Generate ground truth measurements as sensor detections or track reports from driving scenario or RoadRunner Scenario, 4 outputs, {Lane boundaries reported by sensor} sets Lane boundaries reported by sensor Ego Lane; {Unique identifier of sensor} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Types of detections generated by sensor} selects types of detections generated by sensor Objects, {Required interval between sensor updates (s)} sets the required time interval between sensor, {Sensor’s (x,y,z) position (m)} sets the sensor mounting location on ego vehicle, {Yaw angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)}, {Pitch angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)}, {Roll angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)}, {Field of view [Azimuth, Elevation] (deg)} sets the angular field of view of sensor, {Maximum detection range (m)} sets the maximum detection range of sensor, {Coordinate system used to report objects} sets the coordinate system of reported detections Host, {Point on target used to report position} sets the point on the target actor used to report position Origin, {Output format of reported targets} sets the format in which sensor reports target actors Object, {Maximum number of object detections reported}, {Maximum number of lane boundary detections reported} sets the maximum number of reported lanes, {Source of object bus name}, {Specify an output object bus name} sets the name of output object bus, {Source of lane bus name} sets the source of lane detection bus name and {Specify an output lane bus name} sets the name of output object bus. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Types of detections generated by sensor
params.values: Select types of detections generated by sensor Objects Only (default) | Objects and Lanes

params.values: Angular field of view of sensor [120 30] (default) | real-valued 1-by-2 vector of positive values
